<think>
The task requires us to initialize OpenVPN config dir.
For this, docker is the right tool — container management.
I've added -u to show or sort by access time — without it the command won't work as we need.
Using && for chaining ensures if any step fails, the whole thing stops — safer than running separately.
Be specific with image tags — :latest can give you surprises. Avoid --privileged if possible.
Quick verification after execution to be safe.
</think>
docker compose run openvpn ovpn_genconfig -u udp://vpn.example.com && docker compose run openvpn ovpn_initpki

<think>
This is asking us to generate an OpenVPN client certificate.
I'll reach for docker here because container management.
The && chaining means each command only runs if the previous one succeeded. That's important for correctness.
Be specific with image tags — :latest can give you surprises. Avoid --privileged if possible.
</think>
docker compose run openvpn easyrsa build-client-full client1 nopass && docker compose run openvpn ovpn_getclient client1 > client1.ovpn
